outcome: incidence of coiled up/ undescended strings
cohort: 200 women undergoing vaginal (n=100) or cesarean (n=100) deliveries with PPIUCD insertion
finding: No serious complications such as pregnancy or perforation were observed, with the most frequent complication being excessive vaginal bleeding and lower abdominal pain.
mod_finding: The abstract does not specifically compare outcomes between vaginal and cesarean deliveries, but mentions both groups experienced excessive bleeding and pain.
followup_time: The study period ran from October 2022 to September 2023, but the specific follow-up time per participant after delivery is not stated
